lines.zh: 我踩在石头上，骨节咔一声。
lines.en: My joints click once each time I step on stone.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，主人不等我。
lines.en: I walk slowly; my master does not wait.

lines.zh: 没有肉，走路轻得像风。
lines.en: With no flesh, I walk light as wind.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印，不敢超前。
lines.en: I follow your footprints and never step ahead.

lines.zh: 骨头响，是提醒你我在。
lines.en: My bones rattle to remind you I am here.

lines.zh: 我脚踝松了，走一步歪一下。
lines.en: My ankle is loose, so I veer with each step.

lines.zh: 我绕开阳光，晒久了骨头脆。
lines.en: I avoid sunlight; long exposure makes bones brittle.

lines.zh: 台阶太高，我得手脚并用。
lines.en: The step is too high; I must use hands too.

lines.zh: 我走在队伍最后，替人挡箭。
lines.en: I walk at the back and take arrows for others.

lines.zh: 沙地上没有我的脚印。
lines.en: I leave no footprints on the sand.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边捡自己的指骨。
lines.en: I pick up my own finger bones as I walk.

lines.zh: 你走快些，我骨头快散了。
lines.en: Walk faster; my bones are coming apart.

lines.zh: 我站着，等一个不会来的命令。
lines.en: I stand here awaiting an order that never comes.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还剩几根肋骨。
lines.en: I am counting how many ribs I still have.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里有风吹过，很凉。
lines.en: Wind passes between my bones; it is cold.

lines.zh: 没有心脏，也会觉得空。
lines.en: I have no heart, and still feel hollow.

lines.zh: 我学着哨兵的姿势站着。
lines.en: I stand in the posture of a sentry.

lines.zh: 主人不来，我就一直站。
lines.en: If my master doesn't come, I keep standing.

lines.zh: 我在磨自己的指节。
lines.en: I am grinding my own knuckles down.

lines.zh: 风把我的骨头吹得发响。
lines.en: The wind plays my bones like an instrument.

lines.zh: 我记得活着的姿势，忘了原因。
lines.en: I remember how to stand, not why.

lines.zh: 天黑前我得回到阴影里。
lines.en: Before dark I must be back in the shade.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，像在看一堆柴。
lines.en: You look down at me as if at kindling.

lines.zh: 我眼窝里没有眼睛，也能看见。
lines.en: My sockets hold no eyes, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 你不是我的主人。
lines.en: You are not the one I serve.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲很亮，晃我的眼窝。
lines.en: Your armor is bright and stings my sockets.

lines.zh: 我看你，是想记住脸。
lines.en: I look at you to memorize your face.

lines.zh: 你会不会给我一个命令？
lines.en: Would you give me one command?

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，我骨头都紧了。
lines.en: We are too close; my bones are drawing tight.

lines.zh: 你活着，我能闻出来。
lines.en: You are alive; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我的下颌骨合不拢。
lines.en: My jaw will not close all the way.

lines.zh: 别踢我，我经不起一脚。
lines.en: Don't kick me; I won't take one kick.

lines.zh: 疼我倒不怕，怕的是散。
lines.en: Pain doesn't scare me; falling apart does.

lines.zh: 你打断了我一根肋骨。
lines.en: You have broken one of my ribs.

lines.zh: 我的手臂掉了，捡一下。
lines.en: My arm came off; pick it up, please.

lines.zh: 肋骨在响，像旧木门。
lines.en: A rib creaks like an old wooden door.

lines.zh: 补一补还能用，别急着埋。
lines.en: Patch me up; I can still work.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打回了骨头。
lines.en: That blow knocked me back to bare bone.

lines.zh: 我掉了一地的碎骨。
lines.en: I left shattered bone all over the ground.

lines.zh: 主人不会来修我。
lines.en: My master will not come to mend me.

lines.zh: 疼是活的证据，我居然还有。
lines.en: Pain proves life; I still have some.

lines.zh: 我跪下了，膝盖撑不住。
lines.en: I have knelt; my knees gave out.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，牙都没了。
lines.en: I don't eat; my teeth are mostly gone.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，我咬不动。
lines.en: That meat in your hand, I couldn't chew it.

lines.zh: 骨头喂骨头，太怪了。
lines.en: Feeding bone to bone would be strange.

lines.zh: 我只听命令，不听食物。
lines.en: I answer to orders, not to food.

lines.zh: 面包对我是块石头。
lines.en: Bread is a stone to me.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我也没兴趣。
lines.en: Put it down; I still have no interest.

lines.zh: 我的胃早烂完了。
lines.en: My stomach rotted away long ago.

lines.zh: 拿开，我闻不出香味。
lines.en: Take it away; I cannot smell it.

lines.zh: 给主人吧，我用不上。
lines.en: Give it to my master; I have no use.

lines.zh: 诱惑对死人不算什么。
lines.en: Temptation means little to the dead.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，我掉了两颗牙。
lines.en: One bump and two of my teeth fell out.

lines.zh: 我很轻，你却撞得我散架。
lines.en: I am light, yet you knocked me apart.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的骨头太占地方。
lines.en: Sorry; my bones take up too much room.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的肋骨了。
lines.en: You are standing on my rib.

lines.zh: 我退后，脚骨卡进土里。
lines.en: I step back and my foot bone sticks in dirt.

lines.zh: 手别碰我锁骨，那儿松了。
lines.en: Don't touch my collarbone; it is loose.

lines.zh: 我撞你，是想让路。
lines.en: I bumped you because I meant to yield.

lines.zh: 你的马差点踩断我的手骨。
lines.en: Your horse nearly snapped my hand bones.

lines.zh: 我掉了一节脊椎，帮我捡下。
lines.en: I dropped a vertebra; please pick it up.

lines.zh: 挨这么近，我的关节会响。
lines.en: This close, my joints start to creak.

lines.zh: 我只为服侍而来，不为别的。
lines.en: I was made to serve, not for that.

lines.zh: 骨头和骨头不会生出什么。
lines.en: Bone and bone will never make anything.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都是同一批骨头。
lines.en: My companions are all from the same pile of bones.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有那种事。
lines.en: There is no such thing between us.

lines.zh: 主人没教过我这个。
lines.en: My master never taught me that.

lines.zh: 我连结伴的念头都没有。
lines.en: I don't even have the idea of pairing.

lines.zh: 别问了，我只是一副工具。
lines.en: Stop asking; I am only a tool.

lines.zh: 这副骨头是用来干活的。
lines.en: These bones are for labor, nothing more.

lines.zh: 找伴别来问我这副架子。
lines.en: Don't ask this frame of bones for company.

lines.zh: 我的同类不繁殖，只被造出。
lines.en: My kind are not bred; we are made.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只会掉骨头。
lines.en: When I pick things up, I drop bones.

lines.zh: 那把剑我拿得动，砍不动。
lines.en: I can lift that sword, not swing it.

lines.zh: 我手指缺了两节，抓不牢。
lines.en: I am missing two finger joints, so my grip slips.

lines.zh: 这块盾比我整个还重。
lines.en: That shield weighs more than all of me.

lines.zh: 我给你搬，但别指望我搬远。
lines.en: I'll carry it for you, just not far.

lines.zh: 我捡起骨头，想拼回身上。
lines.en: I pick up bones and try to refit them.

lines.zh: 拿不动就拖着走。
lines.en: If I can't lift it, I drag it.

lines.zh: 这件甲，我穿上会散架。
lines.en: Wear that armor and I would fall apart.

lines.zh: 我的背包是空的，从来都是。
lines.en: My pack is empty; it always has been.

lines.zh: 你掉的护符，我塞进肋骨间。
lines.en: I tucked your dropped charm between my ribs.

lines.zh: 命令来了，我认得目标。
lines.en: The order came; I know the target.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太响，藏不住。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我眼窝里没有光，也盯着你。
lines.en: My sockets hold no light, yet they hold you.

lines.zh: 主人抬手往这指，我就出发。
lines.en: My master raised a hand this way; I set out.

lines.zh: 谁挡路，谁就是我的活。
lines.en: Whoever blocks the road is my work.

lines.zh: 我先看你手里有没有武器。
lines.en: First I check whether your hands hold steel.

lines.zh: 你踏进这块地，就归我管。
lines.en: Step onto this ground and you are mine.

lines.zh: 我记得你上次跑掉的方向。
lines.en: I remember which way you fled last time.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，那是开战的意思。
lines.en: My bones are rattling; that means it begins.

lines.zh: 我不怕死，本来就死了。
lines.en: I don't fear death; I am already dead.

lines.zh: 命令上写的名字，念着像你。
lines.en: The name on my orders sounds like yours.

lines.zh: 别喊，没人会来救你。
lines.en: Don't shout; nobody is coming for you.

lines.zh: 我的任务清单上添了你。
lines.en: Your name is now on my list of tasks.

lines.zh: 站住，我奉命带走你。
lines.en: Halt; I am ordered to take you away.

lines.zh: 你的脚印还热，我跟着就来了。
lines.en: Your footprints are still warm, and I followed them here.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲响了一声，我就转头。
lines.en: Your armor clinks once, and I turn my head.

lines.zh: 地牢的钥匙在你身上，我要它。
lines.en: You carry the dungeon key; I want it.

lines.zh: 你退到第三步，脚跟碰墙了。
lines.en: Third step back and your heel meets stone.

lines.zh: 你盾举太高，肋下是空的。
lines.en: Your shield rides high; your ribs are open.

lines.zh: 我绕左边，我的左腿更利索。
lines.en: I take the left; my left leg is quicker.

lines.zh: 你的马在喘，跑不远了。
lines.en: Your horse is panting; it won't run far.

lines.zh: 我在等你的箭射完。
lines.en: I am waiting for your arrows to run out.

lines.zh: 骨头不怕疼，只怕散。
lines.en: Bones don't fear pain, only coming apart.

lines.zh: 你身后是墙，我看得清。
lines.en: There is a wall behind you; I can see it.

lines.zh: 别回头，我就在那。
lines.en: Don't turn around; I am right there.

lines.zh: 我的关节声是给你听的。
lines.en: The creak of my joints is meant for you.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我越不着急。
lines.en: The more you run, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 我算好了三步之内。
lines.en: I have it worked out within three steps.

lines.zh: 火光里我看不清，你更看不清。
lines.en: Firelight blinds me, but it blinds you more.

lines.zh: 你在喘，我不需要喘。
lines.en: You need breath; I do not.

lines.zh: 这条退路，我比你先看过。
lines.en: I walked this escape route before you did.

lines.zh: 你举着火把后退，影子先出卖你。
lines.en: You back away with your torch, and your shadow gives you away.

lines.zh: 我数你的箭，只剩三支。
lines.en: I count your arrows: only three left.

lines.zh: 你踩到碎骨，声音比我大。
lines.en: You step on old bones, louder than I am.

lines.zh: 我记下你的盾，缺口在左边。
lines.en: I note your shield, and the gap on your left.

lines.zh: 你靠在门框上喘，门框挡不住我。
lines.en: You lean on the doorframe to breathe; it will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我的头骨微微歪着，是在看你的脚。
lines.en: My skull tilts slightly; I am watching your feet.

lines.zh: 我的剑很钝，砸也够疼。
lines.en: My blade is dull; the blow still hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下用的是骨头，不是刀。
lines.en: That strike was bone, not the blade.

lines.zh: 我手臂断了，还能挥。
lines.en: My arm is broken and still swings.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡了三次，第四次没有。
lines.en: Your armor stopped three blows, not the fourth.

lines.zh: 我不瞄准，我只往上撞。
lines.en: I don't aim; I just lunge upward.

lines.zh: 打你一下，我掉一根指骨。
lines.en: Each hit I land costs me a finger bone.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我不会疼。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I wouldn't know.

lines.zh: 主人要的是你的命，不是钱。
lines.en: My master wants your life, not your coin.

lines.zh: 我砸你的膝盖，那里没有甲。
lines.en: I go for your knee, where the armor stops.

lines.zh: 剑掉了，我就用头骨撞。
lines.en: The sword fell, so I strike with my skull.

lines.zh: 这一击我练了很多年。
lines.en: I have practiced this one strike for years.

lines.zh: 你的血溅在我肋骨上。
lines.en: Your blood is on my ribs now.

lines.zh: 倒下的是你，不是我。
lines.en: The one falling is you, not me.

lines.zh: 我出手很慢，但不会停。
lines.en: I swing slowly, and I never stop.

lines.zh: 我一剑砍在你盾沿上，盾沿卷了。
lines.en: My blade bites your shield rim, and the rim curls.

lines.zh: 你的脚被我踩住，动不了。
lines.en: I pin your foot, and you cannot move.

lines.zh: 我不是生出来的，是被叫来的。
lines.en: I was not born; I was called.

lines.zh: 骨头从土里拼成一个人形。
lines.en: Bones rise from the dirt and assemble a shape.

lines.zh: 没有生成记录，只有召唤。
lines.en: I have no spawn record, only a summons.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，主人已经走了。
lines.en: When my sockets opened, my master had gone.

lines.zh: 这具骨头是从别人身上借的。
lines.en: These bones were borrowed from someone else.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己是谁。
lines.en: I do not remember who I was.

lines.zh: 泥还在我骨缝里。
lines.en: Mud is still packed between my bones.

lines.zh: 我出现时，蜡烛刚好灭了。
lines.en: The candle went out just as I appeared.

lines.zh: 没有掉落表，我死后不留东西。
lines.en: No loot table; I leave nothing behind.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛边上站起来。
lines.en: I stand up beside the altar.

lines.zh: 骨头先动，皮肉从来没有。
lines.en: The bones moved first; flesh never came.

lines.zh: 我被拼好，就有了任务。
lines.en: I was assembled, and given a task.

lines.zh: 你听见咔的一声，那是我。
lines.en: You heard a click; that was me arriving.

lines.zh: 我不是自然长出来的东西。
lines.en: I am not something the world grew.

lines.zh: 火把我的骨头烤黑了。
lines.en: The fire has charred my bones black.

lines.zh: 从崖上滚下，我少了半副骨架。
lines.en: Rolling off the cliff cost me half a skeleton.

lines.zh: 水里我浮不起来，也沉不下去。
lines.en: In water I neither float nor sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我骨头飞了一地。
lines.en: The blast scattered my bones everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我肋骨中间。
lines.en: The arrow is lodged between my ribs.

lines.zh: 魔法让我骨头自己动起来。
lines.en: Magic makes my bones move on their own.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿是习惯。
lines.en: I don't eat; hunger is just habit.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我骨头在发光。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my bones are glowing.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连骨头都没了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, even my bones are gone.
